title: 2. Administrator Guide: Frame Compilation and Second-Stage Sampling
text: Choose column defines first-stage cluster/stratum (e.g., area_id ea). 4-digit random seed pre-populated reproducibility. Record customize seed (sampSEED) exact sample draw can replicated. Balanced (Generalized Random Tessellation Stratified - GRTS): Draws spatially balanced sample within Enumeration Area using spsurvey::grts(). ensures sampled buildings well-distributed across geography cluster rather clumped one corner. Balanced w. minimum distance: Enables Minimum distance m (mindist) numeric input. Prior sampling, susolisting automatically projects WGS84 coordinates appropriate UTM zone (EPSG:326xx EPSG:327xx meters) via project_to_utm() passes mindis spsurvey::grts() two sampled buildings closer specified threshold ( feasible). Random (Independent Random Sample - IRS): Draws equal-probability simple random sample within cluster using spsurvey::irs(). Target number buildings sample per Enumeration Area (default: 12). Automatic Small-Cluster Handling: Enumeration Area contains fewer listed buildings n_sample (example, 8 buildings listed rural cluster), susolisting automatically caps stratum sample size available cluster population (pmin(n_sample, cluster_count)), selecting available units cluster without error.

title: 1. Enumerator Guide: Marking Buildings in Enumeration Areas
text: Survey Solutions Listing Application (susolisting) enables desk enumerators build complete second-stage sampling frame buildings within first-stage Enumeration Areas (EAs). Starting zipped ESRI shapefile EA boundary polygons (typically produced JDC-Survey Solutions Spatial Sampling Application), enumerators step polygon high-resolution satellite imagery place marker every visible building rooftop. application supports two satellite imagery providers: Google Maps (provider = "google", default): Uses googleway render Google Satellite imagery. Vantor / Maxar Vivid Mosaic (provider = "vantor" "maxar"): Uses leaflet vantorr stream high-resolution (30 cm Standard 15 cm Advanced) OGC WMTS/WMS satellite basemaps optional seamline cutlines.
